title: New Jersey and UK base drone sightings

we have the FBI, we have um FAA, there's drone restrictions in place. Uh there's um the governor's involved, all the elected officials.

plain: In late 2024, strange objects described as drones were reported hovering over sensitive military sites in New Jersey and over bases in Britain. Michels says in his own framing that this shows the link between UFOs and nuclear sites is "ongoing". Elsewhere he names Picatinny Arsenal, where he says they first showed up, the Lakenheath base in England, the Salem nuclear power plant in New Jersey and a plant in Brunswick, North Carolina, and he credits the researcher Robert Hastings. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff, speaking with the skeptic Mick West, stresses how official it got: the FBI and the FAA, the agency that runs US air traffic, were involved, drone flight bans were put in place, and so were the governor and "all the elected officials." The skeptic Michael Shermer calls it "the New Jersey swarm" and ties its timing to Trump's 2024 campaign, while a guest named Harald Malmgren, speaking second-hand, says "we have unidentified objects flying all over the United States."
